,tpda.ASSET_RECOMMAND_ORG ,tpd.PRIN_AMT ,ptpd.REFUND_RATE*100 as REFUND_RATE ,ptpd.REFUND_AMOUNT as REFUND_AMOUNT ,TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.BUSINESS_MODEL as businessModel ,tpda.ou_party_id as ouPartyId ,tpd.TRADER as ouTraderId ,match.exe_id as execid ,decode(tpd.settle_speed,'0','01','1','02','2','03') as settleSpeedStr ,tpd.delivery_type as deliveryType ,tpd.SHARE_AMT/100 as qty ,ttft.fee_amt as procedureAmt ,ttft1.fee_amt as settleServiceAmt ,tpd.clear_type as clearType ,nvl(t2.PARTY_ABBR,tpda.ou_party_id) as ouPartyIdStr ,nvl(t3.real_name,tpd.TRADER) as ouTraderIdStr ,nvl(t1.counter_name,tpd.COUNTER_ID) as counterIdStr ,nvl(t4.TRADER_NAME,tpd.COUNTER_TRADER) as counterTraderStr , '1' as repoType ,ftp.term as term ,tpd.rate as rate ,nvl(reg.SETT_CCY,ic.SETT_CCY) as settCcy ,nvl(reg.DIS_FACE_VALUE,ic.SHARE_CT_AMT) as disFaceValue ,tpd.m_delivery_type as mdeliveryType ,nvl(reg.V_SETTLE_DATE,ic.V_SETTLE_DATE) as vsettleDate ,nvl(reg.M_SETTLE_DATE,ic.M_SETTLE_DATE) PP.PORTFOLIO_ID left join trd_product_deal on TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = tpd.TOTLE_TRADE_ID left join fin_trade_product ftp on trd_product_deal.trade_id=ftp.finprod_id left join trdquto_match_info match on tpd.TOTLE_TRADE_ID=match.trd_id LEFT JOIN TRD_TRADE_FEE_TOTAL ttft ON tpd.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = ttft.TOTLE_TRADE_ID AND ttft.fee_type ='B06' LEFT JOIN TRD_TRADE_FEE_TOTAL ttft1 tpda.ou_party_id left join sys_user t3 on t3.user_name=tpd.TRADER left join MST_CFETS_CUSTOMER_TRADER t4 on t4.TRADER_ID=tpd.COUNTER_TRADER left join reg_fin_product_deal_total reg on reg.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = match.PRE_TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN ibu_quote_crep ic ON ic.quote_id = match.PRE_TRADE_ID WHERE tpd.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = #{totleTradeId}

disFaceValue, T1.clear_type clearType, T1.Delivery_Type deliveryType, T1.m_delivery_type as mdeliveryType, ttft.fee_amt trdFeeAmt, ttft1.fee_amt settleFeeAmt, SYS_DATADICT_LIST sdl_sd on sdl_sd.DICT_CODE = 'SECRATE_DATA' and sdl_sd.ITEM_CODE = fpi.INT_RATE_ID LEFT JOIN MST_CFETS_CUSTOMER_INFO m1 on wbo.OUR_TRADER=m1.PARTY_ID LEFT JOIN MST_COUNTER_PARTY mcci ON wbo.COUNTER_ID= mcci.COUNTER_ID where wbo.BID_ID = #{bidId}

SELECT brbp.ENTRUST_ID entrustId, pp.PORTFOLIO_NAME portfolioName, brbp.SUBSCRIPTION_AMOUNT/10000 subAmt, brbp.PAYABLE_AMOUNT payableAmount, brbp.SETT_FEE_AMT settleFeeAmt, eed.INV_AIM invAim, eed.SEC_ACCT_ID secManageAcctId, ssai.SEC_ACCT_NAME secManageAcctIdStr, bo.dip_Type dipType from BID_ORDER bo left join BID_ORDER_BID_PRICE brbp on bo.BID_ID = brbp.BID_ID left join PTL_PORTFOLIO pp on brbp.PORTFOLIO_ID = pp.PORTFOLIO_ID left join ETR_ENTRUST_DETAIL eed on brbp.ENTRUST_ID = eed.ENTRUST_ID and brbp.PORTFOLIO_ID = eed.PORTFOLIO_ID left join STL_SEC_ACCT_INFO ssai on ssai.SEC_ACCT_ID = eed.SEC_ACCT_ID where bo.BID_ID = #{bidId} UNION ALL SELECT wbrbp.ENTRUST_ID entrustId, pp.PORTFOLIO_NAME portfolioName, wbrbp.SUBSCRIPTION_AMOUNT/10000 subAmt, wbrbp.PAYABLE_AMOUNT payableAmount, wbrbp.SETT_FEE_AMT settleFeeAmt, eed.INV_AIM invAim, eed.SEC_ACCT_ID secManageAcctId, ssai.SEC_ACCT_NAME secManageAcctIdStr, wbo.dip_Type dipType from WFL_BID_ORDER wbo left join WFL_BID_ORDER_BID_PRICE wbrbp on wbo.BID_ID = wbrbp.BID_ID left join PTL_PORTFOLIO pp on wbrbp.PORTFOLIO_ID = pp.PORTFOLIO_ID left join ETR_ENTRUST_DETAIL eed on wbrbp.ENTRUST_ID = eed.ENTRUST_ID and wbrbp.PORTFOLIO_ID = eed.PORTFOLIO_ID left join STL_SEC_ACCT_INFO ssai on ssai.SEC_ACCT_ID = eed.SEC_ACCT_ID where wbo.BID_ID = #{bidId}
